description: This file defines the class DefaultNamespacedEntityId, which implements the NamespacedEntityId interface. It provides constructors and static factory methods to create IDs with validation, as well as methods for equality, hashing, and string representation.

classes.name: DefaultNamespacedEntityId
classes.description: Immutable implementation of NamespacedEntityId, representing an entity ID with namespace and name components, including validation logic.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a NamespacedEntityId from a CharSequence, returning existing instances if possible.

methods.name: fromName
methods.description: Creates a NamespacedEntityId with the default namespace and the provided name.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new NamespacedEntityId with the specified namespace and name.
